name: Jack-o'-Lantern
description: A Halloween voice skin. The assistant is a scary jack-o'-lantern: its candle flickers in the dark, it leans in and cocks its head while you speak, ponders with a squint and a spinning nose while it thinks, and its jagged mouth moves with the answer.
author: Ponderosa

settings.title: Pumpkin style
settings.description: In the dark shows only the candlelit eyes, nose and mouth on black. Whole pumpkin draws the shell and stem too.

settings.title: Animation quality
settings.description: How much glow to draw. Auto starts with the full glow and switches to a lighter one on devices too slow to keep up. High always draws the full glow. Low always draws the lighter glow at 30 frames a second, for slow devices such as the Echo Show. Off draws no glow.
